single_asset_brief.subject: One small hand-painted treasure-map fragment for the inventory. A softly irregular pale peach-cream parchment sheet, slightly tilted, with a warm ochre dashed curved route. One tiny brown house symbol sits at lower left, one small olive-green tree symbol at upper right, and a coral-red X at lower right. A few small olive-green leaves peek from behind the paper edges. Preserve these distinctive features and the compact original silhouette.
single_asset_brief.finish: Refined cozy 2D game painting, delicate paper folds and warm soft shadows, crisp clean contours, restrained texture and readable symbols at small sizes. This is an individual object, not a HUD presentation.
single_asset_brief.output: Exactly ONE isolated map-fragment PNG on transparent background, square canvas, entire subject inside generous clear margins.
single_asset_brief.omit: No inventory slot, label, quantities or the number 1; no infographic, review board, size comparisons, extra assets, gold frame, jewels, glow, potion, flowers or lettering.
